# ferriskey_client_scope (Resource)

Manages a client scope within a FerrisKey realm. Realms are seeded with built-in scopes (`openid`, `profile`, `email`, ...); this resource manages additional scopes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ferriskey_client_scope" "billing" {
  realm       = ferriskey_realm.acme.name
  name        = "billing"
  description = "Access to billing data"
  is_default  = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Scope name (the value used in the OAuth2 `scope` parameter).
- `realm` (String) Name of the realm the scope belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Scope description.
- `dynamic_registration_allowed` (Boolean) Whether the scope may be used by dynamically registered clients. Defaults to `false`.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether the scope is a realm-level default scope (`DEFAULT` rather than `OPTIONAL`). Defaults to `false`.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol of the scope. Defaults to `openid-connect`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier `{realm}/{scope_id}`.
- `scope_id` (String) Server-assigned UUID of the client scope.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ferriskey_client_scope.billing acme/4b2d7f90-1111-2222-3333-444455556666
```
